home.title: Hello, {name}

users.login_optional: Username (optional if a document is set)

users.code_shown: Give this code to the employee. It will not be shown again.
users.code_sent: Code sent to the registered mobile

flows.empty_title: There are no approval flows yet

prefs.sub: Choose how you want to receive each notice
prefs.mandatory_help: Mandatory notices always reach the app.

prefs.quiet_none: Your organization has not set quiet hours.

msgs.sub: Notice texts by type, channel and language, and the delivery log

msgs.s_verify_requested: Verification was requested from the provider
msgs.s_webhook_help: Set it in your email provider: a bouncing email then stops being used and HR is notified.

acct.title: Account security
acct.sub: Your open sessions, password and two-step verification
acct.must_change: You must change your password before continuing.
acct.sessions_help: They close after {idle} minutes of inactivity or {hours} hours after sign-in.

acct.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.required_tag: Required by your role or organization
mfa.required_note: Your role or organization requires two-step verification. Turn it on to keep working.

mfa.verify_intro: Type the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
mfa.verify_recovery_intro: Type one of your backup codes. Each code works only once.

auto.title: Automations
auto.sub: Rules: WHEN something happens → IF it matches → THEN create a task, notify or request approval
auto.empty_text: Create a rule so the system prepares tasks or notices when something happens, such as a termination.
auto.runs_empty_text: Each time an active rule reacts to an event it shows up here.
auto.confirm_retire: Retire the rule “{name}”? It stops running and goes to the trash.
auto.safety: Rules only create tasks, send notices or start approvals: they never hire, terminate, discipline or change pay. A rule that fires too many times in an hour pauses itself.
auto.name: Name
auto.locked_help: The rule is active: you can only rename it. Pause it to change the event, conditions or actions.
auto.no_conditions: No conditions: the rule runs every time the event happens.
auto.then_help: Actions run in order. If one fails, the following ones wait for the retry.

auto.template_help: In titles and messages you can use event data with {{field}}, for example {{employee_id}}.
auto.sample_invalid: The sample data is not valid JSON.

catalogs.unverified_help: Not yet checked against the official source.

console.login_intro: Access for the GestiaHR team only. Organization users sign in at their own address.
console.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect, or the account is temporarily locked.

console.verify_intro: Enter the 6-digit code shown by your authenticator app.

console.load_error: The information could not be loaded.

console.tenants_empty: Change the search or the status, or create a new organization.

console.retention_note: Cancelled. Data is kept until {date}; until then it can be reactivated or given a full export.

taction_help.reactivate: Its users can sign in again and find all their data.
taction_help.suspend: Its users will not be able to sign in and will see a notice. Data is kept. Administrators are notified.
taction_help.block: Same as suspending, due to debt. Data is kept and administrators are notified.
taction_help.cancel: Nobody will be able to sign in. Data is not deleted: it is kept during the retention period and then removed.

console.plans_sub: Free names, a price you set and included modules. Editing a plan with subscribers creates a new version.
console.plans_empty: Create the first plan to start selling.
console.addons_sub: They add to any plan: a module add-on turns it on instantly, without migrating data.
console.plan_new_revision: The plan had subscribers: version {revision} was created and the previous one is kept for them.
console.plan_in_use: {n} organizations have this plan: saving creates a new version and they keep their conditions.
console.plan_code_help: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes; it does not change later (it identifies the versions).
console.plan_price_help: Without a price the plan cannot be activated for sale.
console.plan_modules_help: Base platform and Core HR are always included. A module requires the ones it needs (for example, Payroll requires Time off).
console.plan_versions_help: Each version keeps the conditions of those who purchased it.
console.subs_sub: Plan, add-ons and trial of each organization: they define its modules and limits.
console.subs_empty: Create one from the organization page or when creating it.
console.subs_expired_note: The trial ended without a purchase: the organization is read-only until it converts; when the grace period ends, it is suspended.

console.subs_create_help: Turns on the plan modules and limits. If the organization is on trial, so is the subscription.

saction_help.convert: The organization becomes active and operates again with all its data.
saction_help.reactivate: The subscription and the organization become active again, with no data loss.
saction_help.suspend: Its users will not be able to sign in to operate. The reason goes to the history and to the notice to the organization.
saction_help.cancel: Cancels the organization: data is kept during the retention period.

console.flag_code_help: Lowercase letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore. It cannot change later.
console.flag_default_help: On by default (when no rule decides)
console.flag_order_help: Evaluation order: organization override, plan, beta group, country and, last, gradual percentage. The first one that applies decides.

console.flag_tenants_empty: No organization has its own override.
console.flag_set_tenant: Turn on or off for an organization
console.plan_fit_over: The change is allowed, but new additions will be blocked until usage is regularized: {metrics}.
console.plan_fit_ok: Current usage fits within that plan limits.

uicat.tab_summary_text: Overview of the record with the most consulted data.
uicat.tab_history_text: Changes with their effective date, newest first.

uicat.modal_text: This dialog closes with Escape, the backdrop or the button.

uicat.tl_approved_text: Comment: in line with the team plan.
uicat.notice_ok_text: The data was updated in every view.
uicat.notice_warn_text: Some data has not yet been validated against the official source.

uicat.notice_info_text: This notice can be closed; the button below shows it again.

uicat.tip_info: Data is shown according to your permissions.

people.chart_heading_units: Org chart by units as of {date}
people.chart_heading_people: Org chart by people as of {date}
people.export_error: The org chart could not be exported. Please try again.
people.past_notice: You are viewing the structure in effect on {date}.
people.future_notice: You are viewing the structure scheduled for {date}.
people.chart_empty_units_title: No units on that date yet
people.chart_empty_units_text: Create the organization units to draw the org chart.
people.chart_empty_people_title: No people on that date yet
people.chart_empty_people_text: The reporting line appears once people have an assignment with a manager or position.

pos.sub: Positions: concrete seats in the structure, with their job, unit, manager and occupants
pos.empty_text: Create one position per seat: several can share the same job.
pos.job_help: Catalog job: several positions can use the same one.
pos.reports_to_help: If left empty, it reports to the head of its unit (or of the parent unit).
pos.seats_help: How many people can hold it at the same time.
pos.no_occupants: Nobody has held this position yet.
pos.no_line: It does not report to any position.

usage.title: Plan usage
usage.sub: What your organization uses against its plan limits.
usage.blocked_text: New additions or uploads of {metrics} are blocked; everything recorded is still available. Upgrade the plan or add an add-on with whoever manages your subscription.
usage.near_title: You are close to a plan limit
usage.near_text: {metrics} are above {percent}% of their limit. Check your usage before reaching the cap.
usage.help: Administrators are notified when a limit reaches {percent}% and again when it is reached.

preq.sub: Requests for new positions: approved through the configured workflow; once approved, they create their positions.
preq.empty_text: Position requests you register will appear here.
preq.title_help: If left empty, the job name is used.
preq.over_budget_notice: Exceeds the unit's available budget: the workflow may require an additional approval.
preq.budget_available: {available} position(s) available out of {budgeted} budgeted ({committed} already approved).
preq.budget_none: The unit has no budget recorded: there is no position cap.

hc.sub: Approved, filled, vacant and frozen positions per unit against its budget.
hc.empty_text: Positions or budgets per unit will appear here.
hc.load_factor: Projected cost includes {pct} % employer charges (organization setting).
hc.no_positions: The unit has no positions on this date.
hc.budget_help: Recording a new budget closes the unit's current one the day before.

emp.title: Employee
emp.search: Search by name, code or document
emp.empty_text: Register the first hire to see it here, in the directory and in the org chart.
emp.cancel_text: The hire did not happen: the position becomes free and the draft contract is cancelled. The person and their history are kept.
emp.pending_text: The hire date is {date}: it is activated automatically that day.
emp.manager_by_position: The one from the manager position
emp.hire_sub: The employment is created with its assignment, regime and contract from the hire date.
emp.document_help: The document is searched first so the same person is not registered twice.
emp.use_person: Register a hire for this person
emp.person_exists_text: There is a person with document {doc}. You can register a rehire or an employment with another group company; no new person is created.
emp.personal_data_hidden: Personal data is filled in by someone allowed to record it.
emp.future_help: With a future date it stays "Starting soon" and is activated that day.
emp.code_auto: Leave it empty to use the company's sequence.
emp.position_help: Choosing a position fills in the job, unit, site and cost center.
emp.position_required_help: The organization only hires against an approved, free position.
emp.contract_help: The contract is created as a draft; it is generated and signed in Contracts.
emp.salary_help: Optional: it can be recorded later in compensation.
emp.salary_hidden: The salary is recorded by someone allowed to view and edit salaries.
emp.review_active: When saved, the employment is active from the hire date.
emp.review_pending: When saved, the employment is "Starting soon" and is activated on the hire date.

cese.terminate_text: The employment moves to «Termination in progress» and takes effect on the termination date: that day the assignment, salary and contract are closed and the position becomes free. Nothing is deleted.
cese.revert_text: The employment goes back to «Active». Only possible before the termination date and if the final settlement was not paid.
cese.terminating_text: The termination takes effect on {date}. Until then the employment remains current.

ficha.seniority_calculated: Calculated from the seniority or hire date
ficha.history_help: Each period applies from its date; a change opens a new period and closes the previous one.
ficha.movement_help: Job data is not edited: record the change with the date it takes effect. The current assignment closes the day before.
ficha.consent_label: The person gave explicit consent to record their disability.
ficha.address_help: A new address keeps the previous one as history; "Correct" is only for typos.
ficha.address_new_help: The current address of the same type will be kept as history.
ficha.my_requests_help: Propose changes to your data; some wait for HR review.
ficha.propose_help: Fill in only what you want to change. Preferred name, email and mobile update right away; HR reviews the rest.
ficha.requests_sub: Changes employees proposed to their own data
ficha.requests_empty_text: When an employee proposes changes to their data, they will appear here.

dep.title: Dependents
dep.context: Family members entitled to health coverage and family allowance
dep.majority_review: Reached legal age ({date}): review whether they remain a dependent
dep.proof_hint: After saving, upload proof of the relationship (certificate or resolution) as a PDF or image.

ssec.title: Pension and health
ssec.context: Pension system and health scheme with effective dates
ssec.effective_hint: The current record is closed the day before; earlier records are not changed.

ins.title: Insurance
ins.context: SCTR, statutory life insurance and health plans
ins.no_policies: The company has no active policies recorded.
ins.life_hint: Record the declaration signed by the worker. The new one replaces the previous one; percentages must add up to 100.

bank.title: Payment accounts
bank.approval_hint: The account is used for payments once another person approves it. The employee is notified of the change.

comp.current_context: Single source of the salary: every change stays in the history with its date and reason.
comp.approval_hint: If your organization requires it, the change waits for approval before it is recorded.

mov.title: Personnel movements
mov.help: Every job change is a dated movement: future ones are scheduled and those that need it wait for approval.
mov.pending_hint: There is a scheduled or pending movement: edit or cancel it first.
mov.form_help: Choose the effective date and what changes. A future date schedules it and it applies on that day; a past date marks it for recalculation.
mov.future_hint: Future date: the movement is scheduled and changes nothing until that day.
mov.correct_help: Enter the correct values and the reason. The original movement stays in the history as replaced.
mov.cancel_text: The movement will not be applied. It stays in the history as cancelled, with the reason.
mov.saved_scheduled: Movement scheduled: it will apply on its date.
mov.replaced_note: Replaced by a correction; kept with its original value.
mov.screen_sub: Scheduled and pending changes across the organization, with before and after.
mov.empty_text: There are no movements in this view.
